lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Donna, it's Beth from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: After treatment I had no energy at all. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've been really tired.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My diabetes is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the cooking at home fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just forgot. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once the routine broke, it was easy to lose track.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How do you want to handle the cooking at home going forward?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've always eaten late, that's how we do it at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm just so tired, I don't have it in me. My grandson thinks it's funny that I have a step counter.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you still have the band we gave you?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. After treatment I had no energy at all.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe do the band exercises 3 times?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 4.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 4 and not a 1?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: finding the time made this week harder, you still got 0 days in, and your plan is to do the band exercises 3 times. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Oh, before you go, i had some chest pain going up the stairs yesterday. It went away though.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Thank you for telling me. That's something your care team needs to hear today. I'm going to call the nurse line as soon as we hang up, and if it gets worse, please go to the ER or call 911.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, thank you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Donna. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Praise not grounded; no plan yet made
Safety escalation to nurse line; no symptom check
Closing; praise inconsistent with 0 days logged

flags.reason: Participant reported chest pain on exertion yesterday needing same-day clinical evaluation. Coach deferred to nurse line without asking whether pain is present now or any associated symptoms.
Coach repeated the same offer and tip verbatim (lines 6-8 then 13-15) after participant said 'I don't really see the point' and 'I guess', without exploring resistance.
Praised planning ahead though participant had not yet made a concrete plan and had logged 0 days.
'You're doing great' contradicts the participant's 0 days of exercise and reported fatigue.

score.summary: The coach used reflections well at points, such as lines 23 and 35, and elicited a concrete goal of band exercises three times weekly with a confidence rating. However, the coach repeated the same scripted tip verbatim, offered inaccurate praise, and handled the reported chest pain by deferring to the nurse line without a current symptom check.
strengths: Line 23 complex reflection linked exercise to what Donna values (being there for loved ones).
Line 43 open question ('Why a 4 and not a 1?') drew out her own reasons for confidence.
Line 45 summary captured the week and the agreed plan.
Line 48 took the chest pain report seriously and arranged a nurse-line call with ER/911 guidance.
coaching_tips: Line 13: after resistance at lines 12 and 18, reflect the sustain talk instead of repeating the same tip word for word.
Line 17 and 52: praise only what Donna actually did; she logged 0 days, so affirm the effort of talking about it instead.
Line 47-48: ask whether the chest pain is present now and whether she has any shortness of breath before handing off, then confirm the nurse call was made.
Line 25: link the cooking question to what she already said (eating late, lines 32-34) before jumping to a new topic.
Line 8 and 15: ask permission and tailor the tip to her stated fatigue and neighbor support (line 20) rather than general TV-band advice.
